item.title: IND v NZ 2026: “Kohli was standing alone, but Rohit got out”- Aakash Chopra highlights how ex-captain disappointed with the bat
item.description: Former Indian cricketer Aakash Chopra believes that the team's defeat in the third and final ODI against New Zealand was due to a lack of runs from Indian captain Shubman Gill, Shreyas Iyer, and Rohit Sharma. He notably mentioned that Sharma needed to score runs, especially in the most recent encounter. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: “Axar is right back on his heels,” Ashwin gives reality check to Jadeja after dismal show in New Zealand ODIs
item.description: Ravindra Jadeja has come under severe scrutiny for his below-par showing during India’s 2-1 ODI series loss to New Zealand at home. While the veteran all-rounder went wicketless throughout the series, he returned with scores of 4, 27 and 12. Even during the series-deciding defeat in Indore, Jadeja threw away his wicket at a crucial point when Virat Kohli was trying his best to drag India past the winning line. item.description: Virat Kohli was India’s stand-out batter in the just-concluded three-match ODI series against New Zealand, which the hosts lost by a margin of 2-1. While Kohli endured a rare failure in the second ODI at Rajkot and scored only 23, he slammed a record-extending 54th century (124 off 108) in the series-decider at Indore, albeit in a losing cause. item.description: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) on Monday (January 19) rejected reports claiming that it has received deadline from the International Cricket Council (ICC) to take a final call on the national team’s participation in the Men’s T20 World Cup 2026, slated to be held in India and Sri Lanka from February 7 to March 8. item.description: Michael Bracewell’s participation in the five-match T20I series against India could be in doubt after he picked up what New Zealand Cricket (NZC) called "a minor left calf strain" during the series-deciding third and final ODI in Indore on Sunday (January 18).
